title: Marketing Content Manager
description_excerpt:
Blockstream https://blockstream.com/ was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adam_Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers who are passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the world. Today, Blockstream is the leading Bitcoin company, providing cutting-edge infrastructure solutions for enterprises, institutions, and individual Bitcoin users. We develop industry-leading Bitcoin self-custody solutions, Bitcoin-based financial products, second-layer scaling technologies, and enterprise-grade blockchain infrastructure.

We’re looking for a Marketing Content Manager who can bring depth, clarity, and credibility to how Blockstream communicates with the world. This role is equal parts journalist and researcher — someone who’s not just publishing updates but shaping narratives, spotting trends, and ensuring everything we say reflects both thought leadership and technical accuracy.

You’ll manage Blockstream’s content calendar, lead research-driven storytelling, and produce well-informed, engaging material across multiple channels — from long-form articles and reports to social commentary and product updates.

 - Research and analyze industry trends, technologies, and market developments across Bitcoin, fintech, and enterprise infrastructure.

 - Develop original insights, commentary, and “hot takes” that position Blockstream as a leading voice in the Bitcoin ecosystem.
   Plan, edit, and publish content across owned channels (blog, newsletter, social, and website).

 - Work with internal stakeholders — including engineering, product, and communications — to ensure all content is accurate, aligned, and well-positioned.

 - Consolidate and maintain a content library that serves as a single source of truth for public materials and messaging.

 - Uphold Blockstream’s editorial standards — thoughtful, credible, and grounded in technical and economic reality.

 - Support broader marketing initiatives, including product launches, announcements, and thought leadership campaigns.

What We Look For in You (Required Qualifications):

 - 5+ years of experience in content creation, journalism, research, or communications — ideally in tech, fintech, or crypto.

 - Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible and engaging narratives.

CoinTracker https://www.cointracker.io/ is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.



About the Team

Product Marketing sits within Rain's Marketing & Communications team and owns how we bring Rain's card issuing and stablecoin infrastructure to market. The Cards product pillar is our longest-standing product, and includes stablecoin cards that work across the Visa and Mastercard networks, onchain rewards infrastructure that drives loyalty, and thoughtfully crafted capabilities, like scoped cards, that support agentic payments as agents take on more of the world's transacting.
